cobblemon.species.onix.name: Onix
cobblemon.species.onix.desc: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
cobblemon.species.onix-shodo.desc: This chain of immense blocks of ice resembles a giant serpent. Despite its fragile appearance, tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on glaciers and ice as it goes.
